# skill: plan-long-task
saved: installer seed
When: a task needs 3+ steps or must survive round caps. Steps: 1) TOOL plan :: step1; step2; step3. 2) Work steps in order, TOOL plan done <n> each as it lands. 3) Heavy independent steps: TOOL delegate <subtask>, then fold the report into the next step. 4) Stuck: THINK: once, then a DIFFERENT step. Pitfalls: sub-agents cannot delegate and cannot see your plan; pending steps ride along in every prompt - re-read them before each step.
